conventions.name: no-repeated-string-literals
conventions.description: Python source should not repeat the same non-trivial string literal across a matched scope.
conventions.hint: Extract repeated string values into a named constant or shared fixture and reference that name instead.

conventions.name: no-duplicate-functions
conventions.description: Python functions and direct methods should not duplicate another normalized implementation in the matched scope.
conventions.hint: Extract shared implementation into one helper, or make the duplicate implementations meaningfully different.
